notes.title: Zunius Permanent Price Reduction
notes.notes:
Good news everyone! 
We're excited to announce a permanent price reduction for Zunius on Steam. We believe that gaming should be accessible to everyone, and this reduction allows even more players to experience the immersive world of Zunius at an affordable price.

We'd like to express our heartfelt gratitude to our dedicated community of players who have supported us throughout this incredible journey over the last 3 years. Your enthusiasm, feedback, and passion have made Zunius what it is today. We can't wait to welcome even more players into our ever-growing community.

Spread the word among your friends and family. Let them know that Zunius is now more affordable than ever! Together, let's forge unforgettable memories and embark on epic adventures in the world of Zunius.

Thank you for your unwavering support, and we'll see you in-game!

Best regards,
COAF Research

notes.title: High Score Mode now Available
notes.notes:
Have you dreamed of showing the world how good you are at Zunius? Your dreams have now become reality. Play Zunius in High Score mode and pit yourself against the worlds best (and worst) Zunius players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35602530/72b9aa18f5d6f4d235a884709f2735c049a230c4.png[/img]

[h1]High Score Rules Breakdown[/h1]

For you high score fanatics heres a breakdown of the rules
[list]
[*]Kill an enemy = +200 (1.6x if on danger level*)
[*]Kill a boss = +10,000 (1.6x if on danger level*)
[*]Level End Bonus = max((4 - num_times_hit) * 1,000, 0)
[*]Gold Bonus = +100 * num coins (this happens at end of run)
[*]Finish entire game = +5,000
[/list]
* Danger level occurs when you take the orange black hole at end of level. This shows up when you are lucky or if you’ve performed well on the level.
** High score mode occurs on a fixed seed. This means gameplay is exactly the same for all players

See you on the Zunius Scoreboards!

Send in screenshots and win Steam Vouchers!

[*] When you finish the game as Zenith you unlock a new powerup
[*] When you collect that powerup your ship gets a new skin
[*] The first 3 people to send a screenshot of that skin to competition@coafresearch.com wins a $20 steam voucher.
[/list]

Fact - You're losing money if you don't enter this competition.

Happy Valentines day! To celebrate this occasion we have 30% off Zunius in a Steam sale. Your and your boo can enjoy the new major Zunius Update. 

Features include
[list]
[*]HARD MODE now available
[*]Several new achievements that unlock secrets
[*]Multiple new powerups
[*]Several new enemies
[*]Can see which ships you’ve completed game with
[*]Challenges no longer give you unfair items

[/list]
